title: Multi-stage builds: runtime image size versus build cost
hypothesis: A multi-stage build that discards the compiler toolchain produces a runtime image that is hundreds of MB smaller than the single-stage equivalent, at the cost of a small increase in cold build time due to the extra stage and wheel packaging step.

variants.name: single-stage
variants.description: slim + build-essential kept in final image

variants.name: multi-stage
variants.description: builder stage compiles wheels; runtime is plain slim
